policies.title: Returns
policies.tagline: Fourteen days to change your mind.

sections.heading: What can be returned
sections.body: Any unworn piece in its original packaging with the tag intact and the assay certificate, within 14 days of delivery.

sections.heading: Not eligible
bullets: Coins and bars (priced on the day's rate)

sections.heading: How it works
steps: Open the order and tap Request return
Choose a pickup slot; our courier brings a sealed pouch
We inspect the piece within two working days
Your refund goes back to the original payment method

faqs.a: Yes. Refunds go to the buyer; we can issue store credit to you instead.

policies.title: Exchange
policies.tagline: Trade up, resize or swap within 30 days.

sections.heading: Exchange for another piece
sections.body: Within 30 days you may exchange any unworn piece for another of equal or higher value. Pay only the difference.

sections.heading: Old gold exchange
sections.body: Bring any hallmarked gold to a boutique. We credit the full metal value at the day's buying rate, with no melting or wastage deduction.

sections.heading: Steps
steps: Visit a boutique or book a home visit
We weigh and test the piece in front of you
Choose your new piece and settle the difference

faqs.q: Can I exchange online purchases in store?

sections.heading: Included for life
bullets: One free resize within the first year

sections.heading: Caring for gold
sections.body: Remove jewellery before swimming, exercise and household chemicals. Store pieces separately in the pouch provided.

sections.heading: Caring for pearls and stones
bullets: Put pearls on last, take them off first
Wipe with a soft dry cloth after wearing
Avoid ultrasonic cleaners for emeralds and pearls

faqs.q: How long does a repair take?
faqs.a: Most repairs are ready in 3–5 working days; we message you when it's done.

sections.heading: Handover
sections.body: Every parcel is insured and signed for. Bring a photo ID; the courier checks it against the order name.

faqs.q: Can someone else receive my parcel?
faqs.a: Yes, if you add their name in the delivery note before dispatch.

policies.title: EMI & Payment
policies.tagline: Pay your way, in full or over time.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: Card details are handled by the payment gateway; we never store them.

faqs.q: Can I pay part in old gold?
faqs.a: Yes, at any boutique the metal value is credited against the bill.

policies.title: Help Centre
policies.tagline: Answers to the questions we hear most.

sections.heading: Orders
bullets: Track from Orders → the order → timeline
Change the address before dispatch from the order page
Cancel free of charge before the atelier confirms

sections.heading: Sizing
sections.body: Use the size guide from any product page, or visit a boutique for a fitting. One resize is free in the first year.

sections.heading: Certificates
sections.body: Every diamond over 0.30 ct carries a GIA or IGI report; gold is BIS hallmarked. Certificates ship inside the box.

faqs.q: How do I reach a person?
faqs.a: Tap the chat button, then Talk to a live agent, or call the boutique.

about.intro: A family atelier on Setthathirath Road, crafting gold and diamond jewellery for three generations of Lao families.

sections.heading: The atelier
sections.body: Every piece begins as a sketch at our Vientiane workshop. Master goldsmiths shape, set and polish by hand, using techniques passed down through three generations.

sections.heading: Materials
sections.body: We work in BIS-hallmarked 14K to 24K gold, 950 platinum and 925 silver. Diamonds above 0.30 ct carry GIA or IGI reports; coloured stones are natural and disclosed when treated.

sections.heading: Old gold
sections.body: Bring any hallmarked gold and we credit the full metal value at the day's rate, with no wastage deductions. Heritage pieces can be reset rather than melted.

sections.heading: Care for life
sections.body: Cleaning, polishing and prong checks are free for as long as you own the piece. One resize in the first year is on us.

sections.heading: Giving back
sections.body: A share of every bridal set funds the goldsmith apprenticeship at the Lao Handicraft Association.
